verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents registrable webhook callbacks. A developer registers a callback URL for specific events such as invoice.create, and FreshBooks sends real-time HTTP POST notifications to it. Registration uses a verification handshake, and deliveries carry HMAC signatures so the receiver can confirm they came from FreshBooks. Missing for 10: guaranteed delivery latency (the docs say it can range from seconds to minutes), independent or hands-on corroboration.
